title: Read-only production auth runtime source diagnostic
acceptance: only the repository owner can issue the exact diagnostic command on release issue 3072
exact current main is resolved and rechecked before and after protected production inspection
the protected REG.RU host must be a current live-domain IPv4 answer and present the pinned SSH host fingerprint
only boolean validity for active and canonical runtime pairs, same-directory status, deployed revision and source classification are published
protected paths, delivery keys, mail credentials, raw environment, raw logs, passwords, tokens and cookies are never published
the diagnostic performs no production, database, deployment, credential, session or MFA mutation
production remains the existing REG.RU contour and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB
